meta.name: improve-codebase-architecture
meta.description: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码库发现架构优化机会,生成可视化报告并深入剖析
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责维护日渐庞杂的代码库,想找到架构改进的发力点
copy.tagline_en: Scan your codebase for architecture improvements, then dive into each one
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to systematically uncover architecture improvement areas in your codebase

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扫描代码库找出「深化机会」——把浅模块变深的重构，生成一份自包含 HTML 报告写到临时目录并打开；每个候选带前后对比图和推荐强度，末尾给出首要建议；你选中一个后，它再用 /grilling 逐层追问。
howto.when: 需要手动调用才启动。当你指定某个模块、子系统或痛点，或要求做架构审查时，进入扫描流程。

say.text: 扫描这个代码库，把架构深化机会做成 HTML 报告
say.note: 报告写到临时目录并自动打开

say.text: 重点看最近改动最多的模块有哪些深化机会
say.note: 按提交历史定位热点文件

say.text: 我选第一个候选，帮我理清它的约束和测试

howto.what_en: Claude scans a codebase for deepening opportunities-refactors turning shallow modules into deep ones-and writes a self-contained HTML report to the temp dir, then opens it. Each candidate has before/after diagrams and a strength badge.
howto.when_en: Manual invocation only (disable-model-invocation). It starts when you name a module, subsystem or pain point, or ask for an architecture review.

say_en.text: Scan this codebase and turn the deepening opportunities into an HTML report
say_en.note: Report is written to the temp dir and opened

say_en.text: Focus on the modules changed most recently
say_en.note: Uses commit history to find hot spots

say_en.text: I'll take the first candidate; walk through its constraints and tests
